meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审一遍已完成的改动，在交付前盯住目标、约束、代码质量与安全隐患
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚完成一批改动，准备交付却想先确认没有遗漏问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just finished changes and want a final check before handing off the PR

howto.what: 它先自己在真实界面上做手动 QA 并留存证据,再只启动一个 gate reviewer 审查目标、约束、代码质量、安全、遗漏上下文与 QA 证据。QA 无失败行且审查返回通过才算过。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接前,或用户明确要求审查已完成的工作时接管。

say.text: 帮我审一下刚做完的这次改动,先自己跑一遍真实界面
say.note: 先做手动 QA,再启动 gate reviewer

say.text: PR 交接前对这个分支做一次 gate review
say.note: 一个审查代理审查整份改动

say.text: 对照最初目标检查这次改动,看有没有漏掉的上下文
say.note: 核查目标、约束与 QA 证据

howto.what_en: Runs hands-on manual QA on the real surface, then launches exactly one gate reviewer to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Passes only if no QA row fails and reviewer returns APPROVE.
howto.when_en: Use before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

say_en.text: Review the work I just finished; run manual QA on the real surface first.
say_en.note: Manual QA first, then the gate reviewer.

say_en.text: Gate-review this branch before I hand off the PR.
say_en.note: One reviewer audits the whole change set.

say_en.text: Check this change against the original goal and constraints.
say_en.note: Audits goal, constraints, and QA evidence.
